local.title: Privacy and tracking
local.summary: The game works without tracking. With your consent, we store gameplay data including your submitted puzzle answers locally.
local.message:
Who is responsible?
André Matutat, Hochschule Bielefeld (HSBI), Artilleriestraße 9, 32427 Minden, Germany. Contact: amatutat@hsbi.de.

Purpose and data
We analyze gameplay to improve this escape room. All free-text input you submit is stored in full. We also record puzzle steps, hints used, results, timestamps, and random session and participant identifiers. The legal basis is your consent.

Where and for how long?
The tracking file is stored locally on the computer hosting the game. In multiplayer, your inputs are sent to the host; other clients do not keep their own tracking file. The game does not automatically send the tracking file to an online service. It is not deleted automatically and remains on the host computer until it is manually deleted.

Your choice
Consent is voluntary. If one multiplayer participant declines, recording stops for the shared run. Data already stored remains until deleted. You will be asked again when you next start the game.

Withdrawal and deletion
In the main menu, Settings > Privacy lets you change your decision for the next run and delete tracking files stored on this computer. You can also contact amatutat@hsbi.de to withdraw consent or ask questions. Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before it.

Your rights
You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and data portability. You may complain to the Data Protection and Freedom of Information Commissioner of North Rhine-Westphalia: https://www.ldi.nrw.de/kontakt/ihre-beschwerde.
local.settingsSummary: Change your decision for the next run or delete tracking files stored on this computer.
local.deleteMessage: All tracking files in the local tracking folder will be deleted, including files for other saves or rooms using that folder. Savegames and quest-log data remain unchanged. Continue?
local.deleted: Local tracking files were deleted. No further data will be recorded for this run.
local.deleteFailed: Not all local tracking files could be deleted. Check the tracking folder on this computer.

central.title: Privacy and tracking
central.summary: The game works without tracking. With your consent, we store gameplay data on a self-managed server in Germany.
central.message:
Who is responsible?
André Matutat, Hochschule Bielefeld (HSBI), Artilleriestraße 9, 32427 Minden, Germany. Contact: amatutat@hsbi.de.

Purpose and data
We analyze gameplay to improve this escape room. All free-text input you submit is stored in full. We also record puzzle steps, hints used, results, timestamps, and random session and participant identifiers. The identifiers are pseudonymous and do not make the data anonymous. Please do not include personal information in puzzle answers. Processing is based on your freely given consent.

Where and for how long?
The tracking data is stored on a self-managed server in Germany. Access is limited to people authorized to perform the evaluation. In multiplayer, data is recorded only while all participants in the shared run have consented. Data is stored until the evaluation is complete and for no longer than 90 days after the game ends.

Your choice
Consent is voluntary. You can play without tracking. If a multiplayer participant declines or withdraws consent, further recording for the shared run stops. Already stored data is deleted according to the retention period.

Withdrawal and deletion
You can withdraw consent at any time in the privacy settings or by contacting amatutat@hsbi.de. Further recording stops after withdrawal. Send requests for access or deletion to amatutat@hsbi.de. Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before it.

Your rights
You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, and data portability. You may complain to the Data Protection and Freedom of Information Commissioner of North Rhine-Westphalia: https://www.ldi.nrw.de/kontakt/ihre-beschwerde.
central.settingsSummary: Change your decision for the next run or manage your tracking data.
central.deleteMessage: This action deletes only the local tracking copy on this computer. To request deletion of centrally stored tracking data, contact amatutat@hsbi.de. Continue?
central.deleted: Local tracking data was deleted. Contact amatutat@hsbi.de to request deletion of centrally stored data.
central.deleteFailed: Local tracking data could not be deleted completely. Contact amatutat@hsbi.de about centrally stored data.
